title: RoadTrip Create Aeronautics
description: modpack for building vehicles and mobile bases aroud Create Aeronautics
body:
Vehicle and mobile bases building themed modpack using **Create Aeronautics**.

Roadtrip adds various tools for player to build functional mobile instances in form of cars or trucks, planes and large ships or airships.

All that you build inside the mobile base will work like normally in the world, chests, furnaces, create machines, crops, etc, inclusive your bed for save you spawnpoint thanks to **Sable** sub-levels.

_At this moment this is a work in progress, it will have some bugs, progress or recepies inconsistencies, in the next versions there gonna be a path for new players that don't know much about the mods and content of the modpack_
